title: Ukholo Olufihliweyo Ngaphakathi Kweendonga Zebhotwe
intro: Embindini wenkundla ekhohlakeleyo egcwele amacebo nekratshi, umphefumlo oyedwa ubambe imfihlo eyingozi. Ejikelezwe ngamandla kunye nezoyikiso zokufa, lo mkhonzi ka-Allah ubukela umthunywa emi yedwa echasene nobukumkani. Xa ukuthula kuba yintsebenziswano, kufuneka kwenziwe isigqibo esinesibindi sokuthetha inyaniso emngciphekweni omkhulu wobuqu.
clues: Ndandihlala phakathi kwabantu abanamandla nabakhukhumeleyo ababengazamkeli iimpawu zika-Allah.
Ndayifihla ukholo lwam okwethutyana ngelixa abo babendingqongile babeceba nxamnye nomthunywa.
Ndathetha ngokuphandle, ndisithi: Ngaba uyambulala umntu kuba esithi, iNkosi yam nguAllah, ngelixa ubungqina obucacileyo bufikile?
Ndibalumkisile abantu bam ngekamva leentlanga zangaphambili nangoSuku lokuBizelana.
Ndibaxelele ukuba umlawuli endimkhonzayo ubonisa uluvo oluncinci, kodwa ubomi obungunaphakade likhaya lokwenyani.
Ndathi: Owu bantu bam, ndilandeleni, ndiza kunikhokelela endleleni elungileyo, kwaye uAllah undihlangule ebubini becebo labo.

trial.label: Ndenzeni?
options: Ubutyebi obuqokelelweyo obunezitshixo ezithwalisa amadoda anamandla umthwalo
Wakha inqaba ephakamileyo ukuze ajonge uthixo kaMusa
Ukholo olufihliweyo lwaza lwamkhusela uMusa ngokuphandle lwaza lwalumkisa abantu bam
Wenze ithole legolide elenza isandi esikhulu
Wayivala indlela yoMprofeti waza wahlekisa ngesityhilelo ngenxa yobutyebi
trial.answer: Ukholo olufihliweyo lwaza lwamkhusela uMusa ngokuphandle lwaza lwalumkisa abantu bam

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
